name: ibkr-trade-analyzer
description: Analyze Interactive Brokers (IBKR) trading history with read-only access. Generates comprehensive reports on trading patterns, P&L performance, portfolio structure, and fee analysis. Supports Flex Web Service API and local CSV/XML file import.

ibkr_flex_token.title: Flex Token
ibkr_flex_token.description: IBKR Flex Web Service token (read-only reporting API key). To obtain: log into Account Management (https://www.interactivebrokers.com/sso/Login) → Performance & Reports → Flex Queries → Manage Flex Web Service → Create or copy your token. This token only grants access to reporting endpoints — it cannot place orders or modify your account.

ibkr_query_id.title: Flex Query ID
ibkr_query_id.description: Numeric ID of your Activity Flex Query. To create one: Account Management → Performance & Reports → Flex Queries → Create New Activity Flex Query. Required sections: Trades, Cash Transactions, Open Positions, Account Information. Set output format to XML. After saving, the Query ID appears in the query list.

proxy.title: Proxy URL (optional)
proxy.description: HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy for IBKR API requests, e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:7980. Leave empty to auto-detect from ALL_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY environment variables.
